start_deadline_seconds = 1
[agents.env]
deny = ["AWS_*", "TOKEN"]
passthrough = ["PATH", "_X*"]

max_open = 1
memory_max = "64M"

swap_max = "infinity"
history_lines = 0
[attach]

[runtime]
default = "tmux"
[web]
external_origins = ["https://bazhen.example.com", "http://localhost:7901"]

pairing = "always"
listen = "loopback"
lan_port = 7942
